title: migrate service is coupled to the stage name `deps` in apps/api/Dockerfile and bind-mounts migrations
evidence: The api runtime stage copies only packages, apps/api and config, so neither migrations/ nor migrate-mongo-config.cjs is in the image. The migrate service therefore builds target `deps` (has root node_modules with migrate-mongo and dotenv) and bind-mounts ./migrations and ./migrate-mongo-config.cjs. If the deploybuild lane renames or removes the `deps` stage, or builds node_modules differently, `docker compose build migrate` fails. Not built here (no docker on this machine).
fix_direction: After deploybuild merges, build the migrate service once and confirm; better, add a dedicated `migrate` stage to apps/api/Dockerfile that COPYs migrations/ and migrate-mongo-config.cjs, and drop the bind mounts.

title: web container cannot reach api same-origin: nginx.conf has no proxy, bundle URL is baked at build time
evidence: nginx.conf only serves static files with an SPA fallback. VITE_API_BASE_URL defaults to empty (same origin) in the Dockerfile, which would hit nginx and return index.html for API paths. Compose therefore defaults the build arg to http://localhost:3300 (browser-to-api cross-origin; api CORS_ORIGINS defaults now include http://localhost:8080). A real deployment needs either a public API URL baked in at build time or an nginx reverse-proxy location (nginx.conf is another lane's file) plus TLS: owner decisions.
fix_direction: Owner to choose public hostnames/TLS; then either set VITE_API_BASE_URL to the public API URL or add an /api proxy_pass to nginx.conf and build with an empty base URL.

title: migrate.build.target `deps` does not exist in lane/deploybuild's apps/api/Dockerfile: docker compose build fails once both lanes merge
evidence: ISS-DEPLOYCOMPOSE-001 materialised. deploybuild commit 643c096 replaced stages base/deps/runtime with base, manifests, build, prod-deps, runtime; no stage is named deps. `target: deps` makes `docker compose build` (and `up`) fail with 'target stage deps could not be found'. The full-install stage with root node_modules (migrate-mongo 14.0.7, dotenv 17.4.2 are root dependencies) is now `build`.
fix_direction: Change migrate.build.target to `build` (or ask deploybuild to keep a `deps` stage / add a dedicated migrate stage), then re-verify with the merged Dockerfile's stage list.

title: .env.example CORS_ORIGINS omits the :8080 web origin, overriding the new compose default
evidence: .env.example sets CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://127.0.0.1:5173. Compose reads .env automatically, so an operator who copies .env.example to .env gets that value instead of the extended default (:8080 added); the browser at http://localhost:8080 is then blocked by CORS because nginx has no API proxy.
fix_direction: Add the :8080 origins to the .env.example value (or leave it empty with a comment), and state it next to WEB_PORT.

title: plain `docker compose up` runs migrate-mongo up against whatever MONGODB_URL the operator's .env holds, with no explicit production gate
evidence: MONGODB_URL has no default (`:?` guard), so nothing runs with an empty environment, but compose auto-loads .env and the repo's documented MONGODB_URL is the shared production cluster. migrate is not under a profile and api depends on it, so `up` performs production schema writes. Only a YAML comment cites D-117 (which authorised a Git checkpoint, not DB writes).
fix_direction: Put migrate behind a profile or make api's dependency opt-in, or require an explicit variable such as ALLOW_MIGRATE=1; owner decision.

title: migrate service cannot run: every migration reads /app/schema/index.json, which the Dockerfile build stage does not contain and compose does not mount
evidence: migrations/20260903100000-baseline.cjs, 20260904120000-meeting-candidates.cjs, 20260925090000-source-watcher.cjs, 20260928120000-watch-heartbeat.cjs each do JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(__dirname, "..", "schema", "index.json"))). With migrations bind-mounted at /app/migrations, that is /app/schema/index.json. Merged apps/api/Dockerfile (main d9992d9 / 643c096): build stage copies only package manifests, packages/ and apps/api; `COPY schema ./schema` exists only in the runtime stage. Compose mounts only ./migrations and ./migrate-mongo-config.cjs. The first migration therefore throws ENOENT. schema/index.json is tracked and not dockerignored, so it is available to mount.
fix_direction: Add a read-only bind mount `./schema:/app/schema:ro` to the migrate service (and note it in the comment), re-verify with a reading of every migration for other paths relative to __dirname/..; ideally run once against a throwaway mongo (local-dev profile) when docker is available.
